lines.japanese: 旧鷲介の部屋で睡眠を取っていた。
lines.english: I was asleep in what used to be Shuusuke's room.

lines.japanese: 夜勤明けの安眠を妨げたのは、例によってケータイの着信音だった。
lines.english: As usual, it was my cell phone that disturbed my peaceful post-shift sleep.

lines.japanese: 「あい……成田工務店・夜勤明け支店です……」
lines.english: “Yeah... Narita Construction, Just-Off-the-Night-Shift Branch...”

lines.japanese: 『おいドラ！　呑気にムニャついてる場合じゃねえよ、目ぇ覚ませ！』
lines.english: “Dora! This ain't the time to lie there mumbling in your sleep! Wake the hell up!”

lines.japanese: うええ、まぁーたエージの野郎かよ……。
lines.english: Ugh. That asshole Eiji again...

lines.japanese: 「あんだよ、もう……っせえなあ……」
lines.english: “What now...? Shut the hell up...”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、アレだろ、鍵だろ。しょーがねえから受けとってやったよ。いま持ってる。これでいんだろ」
lines.english: “Oh, right. The key. I took it off Paru's hands since nobody else would. I've got it now. Happy?”

lines.japanese: 『いや、ちょっと事情が変わっちゃったんだよ。悪りいけどその鍵持ってソッコー、超ソッコーでロッカーの荷物取りに行って！』
lines.english: “No, something came up. Sorry, but take that key and get the bag out of the locker right now. Like, right fucking now!”

lines.japanese: 「あ？　ああ、これロッカーの鍵だったの」
lines.english: “Huh? Oh, so this is a locker key.”

lines.japanese: 『そう、柳木原西口・改札前のコインロッカー。中にバッグがひとつ入ってッから、ソレいったん出して、すぐに安全な場所へ移して』
lines.english: “Yeah. Coin lockers in front of the ticket gates at Yanagihara West Exit. There's one bag inside. Take it out and move it somewhere safe right away.”

lines.japanese: 安全な場所。ついに刑事ドラマみたいなフレーズが出てきた。
lines.english: Somewhere safe. At last, the sort of phrase you heard in a cop show.

lines.japanese: 「なんで」
lines.english: “Why?”

lines.japanese: 『いや、おまえは知らない方がいい』
lines.english: “No. You're better off not knowing.”

lines.japanese: うさんくせえ……うさんくせえ以外の臭いがしねえ。
lines.english: Shady... This reeked of nothing but shady.

lines.japanese: 『聞かれてもポリには、知らないの一点張りで徹せよ』
lines.english: “If anyone asks, you stick to ‘I don't know’ with the cops.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、なんでいちいち事情聴取前提なんだよ」
lines.english: “Why are you already assuming they'll interrogate me?”

lines.japanese: 『万一の話だって。おまえがヘタ打たなきゃ何も起きねえから』
lines.english: “I'm just talking worst-case scenario. Nothing'll happen as long as you don't fuck it up.”

lines.japanese: じゃあ、ヘタ打ったら何が起きるんだ。
lines.english: And what would happen if I did?

lines.japanese: 関わりたくねえ。関わりたくねえ以外の言葉が出ねえ。
lines.english: I wanted no part of this. There were no other words for how badly I wanted no part of this.

lines.japanese: 「その、ロッカーの、バッグ？　俺がソレ取りに行かなかったらどうなんの」
lines.english: “This locker. The bag in it. What happens if I don't go get it?”

lines.japanese: 『警察に押さえられちゃうンだよ』
lines.english: “The cops seize it.”

lines.japanese: 「おォ、いい機会じゃねえか。いっぺん檻ンなか入ってアタマ冷やしてこい」
lines.english: “Great opportunity. Go spend some time in a cage and cool your head.”

lines.japanese: 『馬鹿、ポリの手なんかに渡ったら、逮捕状出るまでに俺のカラダ海の底に沈められてるって！　おまえ、ヤクザ怒らせたら警察より遥かに恐えーンだぞ』
lines.english: “Idiot, if the cops get their hands on it, I'll be at the bottom of the ocean before they can issue a warrant! You piss off the yakuza and they're a hell of a lot scarier than the police.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ？　んだそりゃ。おまえ、どんだけヤバい商売に手ェ出し──」
lines.english: “What the fuck? What kind of business did you get yourself mixed up—”

lines.japanese: 『誠一！　遅すぎじゃボケ、いつまでクソしとんじゃあ』
lines.english: “Seiichi! What the fuck's taking so long? You planning to shit in there all day?”

lines.japanese: 『は、はいっ、ただいま！』
lines.english: “Y-yes, sir! Coming!”

lines.japanese: 『とにかくドラ、こっちはいま正念場だからさ。あとのことは頼むよ、なっ』
lines.english: “Anyway, Dora, this is the critical moment over here. I'm counting on you to handle the rest, okay?”

lines.japanese: 「知らねえよ。頼まれねえよ」
lines.english: “Fuck that. You can't count on me for shit.”

lines.japanese: 『あっ、それと！　連絡は全部こっちからするから。そっちの都合で勝手にかけてきたりすんなよ。今だって俺、龍声舎の目ぇ盗んでこっそりかけてンだから』
lines.english: “Oh, one more thing! I'll contact you when I need to. Don't go calling whenever you feel like it. I'm already sneaking this call while Ryuuseisha isn't looking.”

lines.japanese: 龍声舎。不動産屋の看板を掲げてはいるが、実態は柳木原でも最大勢力を誇る指定暴力団の下部組織。たしかフリーのチンピラであるエージが、もっとも懇意にしている組だ。
lines.english: Ryuuseisha. It hung out a real-estate sign, but in reality it was a subordinate organization of Yanagihara's most powerful designated crime syndicate. If I remembered right, they were the group Eiji, a freelance punk, worked with most closely.

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと待て。おまえヤクザに監視されてンのか。なんだそれ、どんな状況だよ」
lines.english: “Wait. The yakuza are watching you? What the hell is going on?”

lines.japanese: 『いや、ちょっとした出来心だったんだよ。事務所行ったとき、バレずに持ちだせるシチュエーションがたまたま揃っちゃってさ』
lines.english: “It was just a moment of weakness. I happened to be at their office when all the pieces fell into place for me to walk out with it unnoticed.”

lines.japanese: 「おまえ、まさかそのバッグって……ヤーさんからパクった物とか言わねえよな……」
lines.english: “You'd better not be telling me that bag is something you stole from the yakuza...”

lines.japanese: 『いや、後悔してンだって。ほとぼり冷めたら、隙見てこっそり返すつもりなんだ』
lines.english: “I regret it, okay? Once things cool off, I'm gonna find an opening and quietly put it back.”

lines.japanese: 「つまりパクったんだな……」
lines.english: “So you did steal it...”

lines.japanese: 『マジ返すって！　話でかくなり過ぎちゃって、もう俺のレベルじゃ裁ける相手いねえし。金になんねーなら、あんなヤバいもんいつまでも持ってたくねえよ』
lines.english: “I swear I’m giving it back! This got way too big, and I don’t know anyone at my level I can sell it to anymore. If I can’t turn it into money, I don’t wanna keep something that dangerous around.”

lines.japanese: 「そういう問題じゃねえだろ……」
lines.english: “That's not the problem here...”

lines.japanese: アホだ。こいつ、思ってた以上にアホだ。
lines.english: He was an idiot. An even bigger idiot than I'd realized.

lines.japanese: 『反省してる、マジ反省してる！　今回の件が一段落したら、マジ心を入れかえてまともに生まれかわる！』
lines.english: “I've learned my lesson. I mean it! Once this is over, I swear I'll turn over a new leaf and live an honest life!”

lines.japanese: 『だから頼むよドラ、とりあえずバッグだけ回収しといて。ごめん、ほんと悪い、でも頼むよ。俺いまビミョーに疑われてて、自分じゃ思うように動けねンだよ』
lines.english: “So help me out, Dora. Just get the bag for now. I'm sorry, I really am, but please. They kinda suspect me already, so I can't move around the way I want.”

lines.japanese: 「だから、こっちも言ってんだろ。おまえがどんだけヤバい状況か知らねーけど、そんなもんに俺を巻きこむンじゃ──」
lines.english: “And I’m telling you, I don’t know how deep in the shit you are, but don’t drag me into—”

lines.japanese: 『誠一！　出てこいゆうんが聞こえんのか、沈めンぞワレぇ！』
lines.english: “Seiichi! You deaf, asshole? I said get out here before I sink your ass!”

lines.japanese: 『やべ限界だ、鰐淵さんキレてる……じゃあなドラ、俺の命預けたから！』
lines.english: “Shit, that's it. Wanibuchi's losing it... Later, Dora. My life is in your hands!”
“Your life...?”

lines.japanese: そんなもん預けられても困る。
lines.english: What the hell was I supposed to do with that?

lines.japanese: 今日は夕方のバイトが休みだから、せっかく心ゆくまで眠りたおそうと思っていたのに。
lines.english: I had the evening shift off today and had been looking forward to sleeping as long as I damn well pleased.

lines.japanese: すっかり目の冴えてしまった俺は、とりあえずコインロッカーとやらの様子を見に行ってみることにした。
lines.english: Wide awake now, I decided I might as well go see what this coin locker was about.

lines.japanese: 柳木原に着いた俺は、さっそく指定されたコインロッカーを探した。
lines.english: Once I reached Yanagihara, I went looking for the specified lockers.

lines.japanese: ん、これか。
lines.english: Hm. This one?

lines.japanese: さて、どうしよう。やっぱりここまで来たからには、とりあえず中を見てみるか。
lines.english: Now what? Since I'd come this far, maybe I should at least look inside.

lines.japanese: しかし見てしまったらもう、このヤマには無関係でいられなくなる。
lines.english: But the moment I looked, I wouldn't be able to claim I had nothing to do with this mess anymore.

lines.japanese: シカトしたい。シカトして帰りたいが、エージの命がかかっているなら……。
lines.english: I wanted to ignore it. I wanted to turn around and go home, but if Eiji's life really was at stake...

lines.japanese: あんなやつでも一応は顔見知りだ、見殺しには出来ない。
lines.english: He might've been an asshole, but I knew him. I couldn't leave him to die.

lines.japanese: んんー……どうしたもんか……。
lines.english: Nnngh... What the hell was I supposed to do... ?

lines.japanese: 「はーやーとー君っ♪」
lines.english: “Ha-ya-tooo!”

lines.japanese: 「げっ」
lines.english: “Shit.”

lines.japanese: 知ってるやつに会ってしまった。
lines.english: I'd run into somebody I knew.

lines.japanese: 「なに、その反応……傷付くな……」
lines.english: “What's with that reaction...? That hurts...”

lines.japanese: 「あっ、いや、そういう意味じゃなくて。ちょっと、ひとに会いたくない事情があって」
lines.english: “No, I didn't mean it like that. I've just got reasons I don't want to see anybody right now.”

lines.japanese: 「なにそれ」
lines.english: “What reasons?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから言えねえよ。ひとに知られたくねえ用事だよ」
lines.english: “I can't tell you. It's something I don't want anybody knowing about.”

lines.japanese: 「えぇ～何それ何それ、私も付いてっていい？」
lines.english: “Ooh, what is it? What is it? Can I come too?”

lines.japanese: 「駄目に決まってんだろ、ひとの話ちゃんと聞けよ。俺は誰にも知られたくない用事だッつってんの」
lines.english: “Of course you can't. Listen when people talk. I just said I don't want anybody knowing.”

lines.japanese: 「浮気か」
lines.english: “An affair.”

lines.japanese: 「違ぇーよ」
lines.english: “No.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃあ何？」
lines.english: “Then what?”

lines.japanese: 「いや、だから、それは話せないんだけど」
lines.english: “I just told you, I can't talk about it.”

lines.japanese: 「やっぱ浮気だ」
lines.english: “Definitely an affair.”

lines.japanese: 「違ぇーっつうの。つか、なんでそんな嬉しそうなんだよ。ひとの不幸が大好きか、おまえ」
lines.english: “I said it isn't. And why do you look so happy about it? You love other people's misery that much?”

lines.japanese: 「べつに喜んでるわけじゃないけどぉー、じゃなくて、浮気も男の甲斐性なのかなって。そういう考えもあるんだなあって最近思って」
lines.english: “It's not like I'm happy, but... I mean, maybe cheating is just part of being a man. Lately I've been thinking there's a point of view like that too.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、意外。おまえ見た目はチャラそーだけど、根は古典的っつうか、そういう遊んだり遊ばれたりとか大ッ嫌いなのかと思った」
lines.english: “Huh. Didn't expect that. You look flighty, but underneath I thought you were old-fashioned. Like you hated people playing around and getting played.”

lines.japanese: 「や、もちろん嫌いは嫌いだけどさ。そりゃそーなんだけどさ」
lines.english: “I mean, of course I hate it. I definitely do.”

lines.japanese: 「でも前は『ちょおおお信じらんない！』ってカンジだったのが、最近はコトと次第によっちゃ『うん、まあ、分からないでもないかな……』ぐらいに」
lines.english: “Before, I'd have been all, ‘No waaaay! I can't believe it!’ But lately, depending on the circumstances, it's more like, ‘Yeah, okay, I guess I can kind of understand...’”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん」
lines.english: “Huh.”

lines.japanese: その手のドラマでも見たのかね。このぐらいの小娘は、そういうのの影響受けやすいからな。
lines.english: Had she seen some drama about it? Girls her age were easily influenced by that sort of thing.

lines.japanese: 「で、隼人君はいまから浮気相手と待ち合わせなわけだ」
lines.english: “So you're meeting your other woman now, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「アホか。だから、そういうんじゃねーんだって。要はエージっつう極道見習いのチンピラ小僧がいンだけど、こいつが──」
lines.english: “Don't be an idiot. I told you, it's nothing like that. See, there's this little punk named Eiji who's trying to become a gangster, and he—”

lines.japanese: 「──っとぉ！　あっぶね、おまえ誘導尋問うめーな。超びびるわ。思わずノリでぜんぶ語っちゃうトコだったじゃねえかブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “—whoa! Nice try. You're way too good at leading questions. Scared the shit out of me. I almost got carried away and told you everything. I'll fucking kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「あはは、だよねー。隼人君、女を泣かせるような男じゃないもんねー」
lines.english: “Hahaha, I knew it. You're not the kind of man who makes women cry, Hayato.”

lines.japanese: 「そういうこと。んじゃな」
lines.english: “Exactly. See ya.”

lines.japanese: 「うん、ばいばい」
lines.english: “Mm. Bye-bye.”

lines.japanese: 「え、なんでおまえ立ちさらないの」
lines.english: “Wait. Why aren't you leaving?”

lines.japanese: 「なんでも何も。私ここで友達と待ちあわせだもん。てゆか、うち隼人君より先にいたんですけど」
lines.english: “What do you mean, why? I'm meeting a friend here. I was here before you, you know.”

lines.japanese: 「ああそう」
lines.english: “Oh. Right.”

lines.japanese: ま、いいか。
lines.english: Well, whatever.

lines.japanese: べつにこいつはオマワリじゃないんだ。俺がロッカーから荷物出したところで、不審がったり詮索したがったりはしないだろう。
lines.english: She wasn't a cop. If she saw me take something out of a locker, she wouldn't get suspicious and start asking questions.

lines.japanese: 「フンフフ～ン～……」
lines.english: “Hm hm hmmm...”

lines.japanese: 俺はやましいところなど何もない素振りで口笛など吹きながら、鍵と符合するロッカー番号を探した。
lines.english: Whistling and doing my best impression of a man with nothing to hide, I searched for the locker number that matched the key.

lines.japanese: 鍵を挿しこんで、開ける。
lines.english: I inserted the key and opened it.

lines.japanese: 中には古びたボストンバッグが入っていた。
lines.english: Inside was an old duffel bag.

lines.japanese: ジッパーを割って中を開くと──
lines.english: I pulled the zipper open and looked inside—

lines.japanese: ──白い粉がたんまり入っていた。
lines.english: —and found it packed with white powder.

lines.japanese: 見なかったことにしよう。
lines.english: I hadn't seen that.

lines.japanese: いや、こんなバッグ取りに来なかったことにしよう。うん。そうしよう。
lines.english: No. I had never come to pick up this bag at all. Right. That was the story.

lines.japanese: すぐさま口を閉めて、元通りの位置へ押しこんだ。
lines.english: I immediately zipped it shut and shoved it back where it had been.

lines.japanese: 尻ポケから財布を出して、えーと、百円玉が三枚か……。
lines.english: I pulled out my wallet. Let's see... Three hundred-yen coins...

lines.japanese: 「ええーっ！　なんでなんで？　なんでしまっちゃうん？」
lines.english: “What?! Why, why? Why're you putting it back?”

lines.japanese: 「お、おまっ、見てたのかよ……アッばか、無闇に触んな、指紋つくぞ指紋」
lines.english: “Y-you were watching...? Hey, idiot, don't touch it! You'll leave fingerprints.”

lines.japanese: 「ねーねー、いまの何？　いまの白い粉なに？　白い粉たっぷり詰まってたけど何？」
lines.english: “Hey, what was that? What was all that white powder? The bag was stuffed with it. What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「う、うるせえ。でかい、声がでかい」
lines.english: “S-shut up. Too loud. You're too loud.”

lines.japanese: 「なぁーん、そんな隠さなくたっていいじゃん。怪しいクスリじゃないんだからさあ」
lines.english: “Aww, you don't have to hide it. It's not like it's some suspicious drug.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あ、当たり前だ、めめめ滅多なこと言うんじゃありませんよブッ殺すぞコノヤロウ」
lines.english: “O-of course not! D-d-don’t say anything so outrageous, or I’ll fucking kill you.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　なんでそんな動揺してんの……」
lines.english: “Huh? Why're you so shaken...?”

lines.japanese: 「え？　ええっ？　まさかソレ本物の……！」
lines.english: “Wait. What?! Is that stuff actually real...?”

lines.japanese: 「ちょーちょーちょー、なに言ってんの香田さん、そんなわけないでしょ香田さん」
lines.english: “Whoa, whoa, whoa. What are you talking about, Ms. Kouda? Of course it isn't, Ms. Kouda.”

lines.japanese: 「んむーっ！　んー、んー、んん──っ！」
lines.english: “Mmph! Mm! Mmmph—!”

lines.japanese: 「落ちつけ。まずは落ちつけ」
lines.english: “Calm down. First, you need to calm down.”

lines.japanese: 「んっ、んっ」
lines.english: “Mm! Mm!”

lines.japanese: 亜衣が二度頷いたので、解放してやる。
lines.english: Ai nodded twice, so I released her.

lines.japanese: 「いいか、話せば長くなンだけど、とりあえずコレは俺のじゃねえ」
lines.english: “Listen, it's a long story, but for now, just know this isn't mine.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、お巡りさん来るよ」
lines.english: “Oh, a police officer's coming.”

lines.japanese: 「げえっ！　やべ、やべ、やべえ……！」
lines.english: “Gah! Shit, shit, shit...!”

lines.japanese: 「しま、しまっ、しまって早く……！」
lines.english: “Put it away! Hurry!”

lines.japanese: 「オラっ！」
lines.english: “Hrah!”

lines.japanese: 扉を閉じて、百円玉を連続投入。
lines.english: I slammed the door and fed in all three coins.

lines.japanese: 「えっ？！　ええっ、ちょっ……！」
lines.english: “What?! Wait, hey...!”

lines.japanese: 「おし、逃げンぞ！」
lines.english: “All right, run!”

lines.japanese: 鍵を引っこ抜き、亜衣の手を取る──
lines.english: I yanked out the key and grabbed Ai's hand—

lines.japanese: 「きゃあああ、ちょ待って待って待って！」
lines.english: “Aaaaaah! Wait, wait, wait!”

lines.japanese: 「あん？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 「もおお、ばかーッ！　なんだこれ、隼人のばかーッ！」
lines.english: “You idiot! What is this? Hayato, you idiot!”

lines.japanese: 「うおっ……」
lines.english: “Whoa...”

lines.japanese: 慌てて扉を閉めたものだから、スカートの裾を巻きこんでいたらしい。
lines.english: I'd shut the door in such a hurry that the hem of her skirt had gotten caught in it.

lines.japanese: 「わ、悪りい、いまなんとかする……」
lines.english: “S-sorry. I'll figure something out...”

lines.japanese: 「やああぁ、あっち向いてろし！」
lines.english: “No! Turn around!”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああゴメ」
lines.english: “R-right. Sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「んっ……く、取れない……」
lines.english: “Ngh... It won't come out...”

lines.japanese: 「ちょ、隼人君！　ぼけっとしてないで手伝ってよ！」
lines.english: “Hayato! Don't just stand there. Help me!”

lines.japanese: 「どっちだよ。ああもう貸せ、こんなもんオモクソ引っぱりゃ……」
lines.english: “Which is it? Ah, hell, give it here. If I just yank the damn thing—”

lines.japanese: 「ダメーっ！　破れる破れる！」
lines.english: “No! It'll rip! It'll rip!”

lines.japanese: 「いいよもう、こんなんトカゲの尻尾みてーなもんじゃん。破ろうぜ」
lines.english: “Who cares? It's basically a lizard's tail at this point. Let's tear it off.”

lines.japanese: 「馬鹿かー！　も、サイテーだ！　死ね、死んじゃえ！」
lines.english: “Are you stupid?! You're the worst! Die! Drop dead!”

lines.japanese: 「平気だって。今日いいパンツ穿いてんじゃん。見られても恥ずかしくないって」
lines.english: “It's fine. You've got nice panties on today. Nothing to be embarrassed about if somebody sees them.”

lines.japanese: 「フォローになってねえ！」
lines.english: “That doesn't make it better!”

lines.japanese: 「ぶへっ！」
lines.english: “Bwegh!”

lines.japanese: けっきょく鍵を挿して、また扉を開けることで解決した。
lines.english: In the end, we solved the problem by inserting the key and opening the door again.

lines.japanese: くそ、３００円も無駄にしてしまった──
lines.english: Goddammit. I'd wasted three hundred yen—

lines.japanese: ──という愚痴は、亜衣の手前、口にできない。
lines.english: —a complaint I couldn't very well make in front of Ai.

lines.japanese: 「嫁に行けない。もう無理。けがされた」
lines.english: “I'll never be able to get married. It's over. I've been defiled.”

lines.japanese: 「だぁら、悪かったッつってんじゃん」
lines.english: “I said I was sorry.”

lines.japanese: 「何なん、その謝り方。誠意足んなくね？　ちゃんと責任取れし」
lines.english: “What kind of apology is that? You're not sincere at all. Take proper responsibility.”

lines.japanese: 「あァ、責任な。分かった、じゃあ十年ぐらい経ってまだオトコいなかったら俺ンとこ来いよ」
lines.english: “Responsibility, huh? Fine. If ten years go by and you still don't have a man, come find me.”

lines.japanese: 「そんときは責任持って、おまえのムコ探してやる」
lines.english: “I'll take responsibility and find you a husband.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ……ああそう……はーい」
lines.english: “Oh... Right... Sure.”

lines.japanese: しかしパンツ騒動は怪我の功名となったのかもしれない。
lines.english: Still, maybe the whole panty incident had been a blessing in disguise.

lines.japanese: 市民の味方のおマワリさんは、あられもない姿の少女から紳士的に目を背けて通りすぎていった。
lines.english: The friendly neighborhood cop had gentlemanly averted his eyes from the indecently exposed woman and walked right past us.

lines.japanese: そして今、俺の手にはエージのバッグが。
lines.english: And now Eiji's bag was in my hands.

lines.japanese: そしてそのバッグには、香田亜衣の怪訝な視線が。
lines.english: And Ai Kouda's suspicious gaze was fixed on that bag.

lines.japanese: 「……結局ソレ何なん？」
lines.english: “...So what is that stuff?”

lines.japanese: 「俺が聞きてえよ。どーなのよ、コレはアレか。マジもんのアレか」
lines.english: “That's what I wanna know. What do you think? Is it the real deal?”

lines.japanese: 「私に聞かれても困るし。そーゆーのは専門家に聞けば？」
lines.english: “How should I know? Ask an expert about that stuff.”

lines.japanese: 「いや、ちょっとな。事情があって、とりあえず警察は最後の手段にしたい」
lines.english: “There's a situation here. I'd like to keep the police as a last resort.”

lines.japanese: 「じゃなくて、いるじゃん専門家。フレイムバーズに」
lines.english: “I didn't mean the police. There's an expert in the Flame Birds.”

lines.japanese: 「専門家……」
lines.english: “An expert...”

lines.japanese: 「……アレか」
lines.english: “...You mean him.”

lines.japanese: がっくりした。アレじゃなんの頼りにもならない気がする。
lines.english: My shoulders slumped. I couldn't imagine that guy being any help at all.

lines.japanese: 「そいぇば、今日ヘテロでなんかイベントやるってゆってた。ちょうどみんな集まってんじゃない？　行ってみれば？」
lines.english: “Come to think of it, they said there was some event at Hetero today. Everybody's probably there. Why don't you go?”

lines.japanese: 「ヘテロか……」
lines.english: “Hetero, huh...?”

lines.japanese: こんな夜も浅いうちからクラブに出入りするほど暇じゃないんだけど、一応行ってみるか。
lines.english: I wasn't so idle that I spent my evenings hanging around clubs before the night had properly begun, but maybe I should go take a look.

lines.japanese: いや、ジャンキー趣味のレゲエ男はどうでもいいんだけど、連中のヘッドがいるなら話をしてみる価値はあるかもしれない。
lines.english: I didn't care about the reggae guy and his junkie hobbies, but if the head of their crew was there, he might be worth talking to.

lines.japanese: 柳木原の糞ガキたちのあいだで囁かれている噂を聞いたことがある。
lines.english: I'd heard a rumor whispered among the little shits of Yanagihara.

lines.japanese: もしも悪ふざけが過ぎて、おっかない本職のおじさんを怒らせてしまったときは、皇帝を頼れ。かわいい悪戯レベルの初犯であれば、きっと力になってくれる。
lines.english: If your fooling around went too far and pissed off a scary real gangster, turn to the Emperor. If it was your first offense and no worse than a harmless prank, he’d surely help you out.

lines.japanese: 噂はおそらく本当だろう。いまの俺なら分かる。あいつはどっかの馬鹿に憧れてイカれたフリしちゃいるが、本質的には頼れる兄貴を気取りたい寂しがり屋のガキ大将だ。
lines.english: The rumor was probably true. I understood that now. He acted crazy because he idolized a certain idiot, but deep down, he was a lonely little gang leader who wanted to play the dependable big brother.

lines.japanese: 問題はふたつ。
lines.english: There were two problems.

lines.japanese: やつがすでにフレイムバーズのアタマを降りてるってことと、そもそも俺はフレイムバーズの構成員でも何でもないってことだ。
lines.english: He had already stepped down as head of the Flame Birds, and I wasn't a member of the Flame Birds in the first place.
